minimal_priority_list.task: Relax the 9 Pb2Sb2Te5 D/V/O parent cells (PBE-D3, consistent ENCUT/k-mesh; SOC decision recorded) and verify they remain the intended rocksalt/ordered occupation.
Regenerate the 12 neutral defect types from each relaxed parent (not the unrelaxed POSCARs), run static energies, and compute neutral formation energies with a common chemical-potential convention.
For the competitive defects (Sb_Pb, Pb_Sb, Pb_on_Vac, Sb_on_Vac, V_Te, V_Pb, V_Sb), add relevant charge states across the gap, finite-size corrections, and a charge-neutrality solution.
Repeat the same D/V/O protocol for Pb2Bi2Te5 to test the Bi/Sb contrast; do not infer the contrast from the old 81-atom project.
Only after 1-4: connect defect-limited n/p and mobility to transport; static 0 K formation energies alone do not give an annealing temperature or a P/N switch.
